items.text:
I really really want to like this game but the combination of obtuse controls and the bugs are making it unplayable for me. From unexplained error logs randomly popping up to my character not completing tasks (ie trying to install a new battery before she asphyxiates and she decided to stop working) then when canceling a task to force a start over since she won't work, the battery just disappears! I have 8 hours of play time and I haven't been able to complete a tutorial wreck yet. I suppose I'll wait until there is some qol and polish and I'll give it another try later as this is extremely frustrating.

Edit: keeping as recommended, because the devs actively engage to work out issues and are regularly adding new patches.
items.text_zh:
我真的真的很想喜欢这款游戏，但晦涩难懂的操作和bug的结合让我玩不下去。从莫名其妙随机弹出的错误日志，到我的角色无法完成任务（比如在她窒息前尝试安装新电池，她却决定罢工），然后当取消任务以强制重新开始时，因为角色不肯干活，电池就这么消失了！我已经玩了8个小时，却连一个教程残骸都没能完成。我想我会等到有一些生活质量改进和打磨之后再试一次，因为这实在太令人沮丧了。

编辑：保留推荐，因为开发者积极互动解决问题，并定期添加新补丁。
